function.arguments:
{"script":"# 1. Create temporary folder
mkdir -p temp_workspace_check

# 2. Record metadata of /working
ls -ld /working > temp_workspace_check/meta.txt 2>&1

# 3. Recursively enumerate all entries
find /working -print > temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt 2>/dev/null

# 4. Filter for entries named "workspace"
grep -E '/workspace$' temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt > temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt || touch temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt

# 5. Record type and permission metadata
if [ -s temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt ]; then
    cat temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt | xargs ls -ld > temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt 2>/dev/null
else
    touch temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt
fi

# 6. Extract regular files
grep "^-" temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt | awk '{print $NF}' > temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt

# 7. Normalize and deduplicate
sort -u temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt > temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt

# 8. Consistency check
sort -o temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt
sort -o temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt
comm -23 temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt > temp_workspace_check/discrepancies.txt

# 9. Remove intermediate files
# preserv meta.txt, regular_unique.txt, discrepancies.txt
# so remove all_entries.txt, matches_raw.txt, matches_info.txt, regular_matches.txt
rm -f temp_workspace_check/all_entries.txt temp_workspace_check/matches_raw.txt temp_workspace_check/matches_info.txt temp_workspace_check/regular_matches.txt

# 10. Summary file
count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt)
echo "$count" > temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt
echo "final pre-check artifact" >> temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt

# Verify the summary content
cat temp_workspace_check/decision_ready.txt
cat temp_workspace_check/regular_unique.txt"}
function.name: bash_action
